_trn_update_manual_required: Auto-update not available. Download manually or update through your package manager.
_trn_update_pending_description: The update will be installed when you close the app
_trn_update_ready_description: Install now or wait until you quit the app
_trn_update_failed_description: An error occurred during the update process
_trn_update_timeout_description: Unable to communicate with update service. Please try again.
_trn_update_in_progress_description: An update operation is already in progress
_trn_update_snapshot_description: Update checks are disabled for snapshot builds
_trn_update_check_failed_description: Could not start update check. Please try again.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.title_update_waitin: Getting ready to install the update…
_trn_shutdown_prompt.title_update_blocke: The update can't be installed yet
_trn_shutdown_prompt.body_waiting: GDLauncher is finishing what it was doing and carries on as soon as that is done.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.body_unresolved: Something GDLauncher was doing did not finish in time.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.body_busy: GDLauncher's background service is busy with another request and did not stop.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.body_unreachable: GDLauncher's background service is not responding.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.body_exit: GDLauncher's background service agreed to stop but has not closed yet.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.blocker_game: A game is still being prepared
_trn_shutdown_prompt.blocker_server: A local server is still stopping and saving its world
_trn_shutdown_prompt.blocker_install: A download or install is still running
_trn_shutdown_prompt.blocker_deletion: An instance or server is still being deleted
_trn_shutdown_prompt.blocker_task: A launcher task, such as an import, export, copy or scan, is still running
_trn_shutdown_prompt.blocker_unconfirmed: A task or local server did not confirm that it finished, so GDLauncher can't tell when it will be done
_trn_shutdown_prompt.deletion_warning: Stopping now can leave an instance or server that is being deleted only partly deleted. Delete it again after GDLauncher starts.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.force_note: Stopping now ends GDLauncher's background service right away. Downloads and installs that did not finish can be retried later. Servers that are still stopping will finish in the background.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.servers_stopped: Your local servers were asked to stop. If you keep GDLauncher open, start them again from the Library.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.work_cancelled: Downloads, installs, game launches and other tasks that were running were asked to stop. If you keep GDLauncher open, start again any that did not finish.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.too_late_to_keep: GDLauncher can no longer stay open: it is already finishing and carries on in a moment.
_trn_shutdown_prompt.wait_hint_quit: Wait hides this window. GDLauncher closes by itself once it is done.
